name: Latted
long_description:
Latted is an all-in one tool to generate and edit professional AI video projects.

All professional AI video projects take more than a single generation. You need to juggle between hundreds of images and videos and use multiple tools to edit your project.

With Latted, you can generate a 10-minute long video from a single prompt or generate and edit your project from scratch.

Thousands of creators use Latted for marketing videos, content creation and educational content. Create your first project today at latted.com!
one_liner: A Unified Editor For AI Video

launches.title: Fume - AI SWE that solves bugs within Slack
launches.tagline: A Slack bot that you can assign software tickets and get full PRs in response
launches.body:
**TL;DR** You can tag @Fume under any feature or bug ticket in Slack. Fume will make a plan, write code, and submit a PR in minutes. [**Try it now! No waitlist. No 'contact sales'.**](http://fumedev.com)

Hey folks! We are [Emre](https://linkedin.com/in/aegucer) and [Mete](https://linkedin.com/in/metehan-oz-a39981251). We’re currently building Fume to automate the boring parts of developing software. Before that, we were roommates in high school and partners in crime, building fighting bots.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79085&key=user_uploads/1573638/314fd0c9-7a62-4aa6-9e91-6d29c4cec454)

### 💥**Problem**

Not every software task requires human creativity. Some are just boring and have to be done. Engineers end up procrastinating on them at the cost of user experience. On the other hand, doing them costs companies thousands of dollars every year.

### 🤩 **Not Anymore**

Fume automates mundane software work like fixing bugs, error logs, or minor features through Slack. A non-technical team member can send screenshots & reproduction steps for a bug and an engineer can tag @Fume to solve it within minutes without opening a code editor.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79085&key=user_uploads/1573638/85ea9b9a-969c-4552-9e19-e1437d3f5d55)

### 🙏 **Our Ask**

Give Fume a try right now! Go to [fumedev.com](http://fumedev.com) and enjoy the free trial. If you think you are not ready to start using Fume, tell a friend about it 😉

If you are in a larger organization but want to try Fume in your team, contact me at [emre@fumedev.com](mailto:emre@fumedev.com).
